name: Tsuki ni Yorisou Otome no Sahou 2.2 AxL+SA!!
original_name: 月に寄りそう乙女の作法2.2 A×L+SA!!
source: Contains after story episodes of Sakuri & Lumine, with addition of Sakurakouji Atre's route which continues from the bad end of Tsuki ni Yorisou Otome no Sahou 2.
translation: 包含《Sakuri & Lumine》的后续故事情节，并添加了从《Tsuki ni Yorisou Otome no Sahou 2》Bad End延续的Sakurakoji Atre路线。
